scope: Only this entity is searched and erased. If the person also uses another entity, repeat the procedure there.

search.title: Search by email address
search.hint: The address is sent to the server without appearing in the page address, and is forgotten when you leave this page.
search.done: Search complete. The results are shown below the form.

summary.title: Data found in this entity
summary.nothing: No data linked to this address was found in this entity. Erasing still removes any pending verification code or deposit session.
summary.securityNote: The security log never records email addresses, so it holds nothing to erase.

erase.title: Erase all the data of this address
erase.scope: Only this entity is affected: the same address in another entity is left untouched.

erased.verified: verification codes, deposit sessions and the verified address record;
erased.sent: transfers sent by the address, or deposited through an invitation it received: files made unreadable (keys destroyed) and deleted;
erased.received: transfers received: the address is removed from the recipients, and a transfer left without recipients is deleted;
erased.invitations: invitations it received are deleted; invitations it issued are revoked;
erased.audit: audit log: the address is replaced by a pseudonym (erased-…).

kept.blocklist: blocklist entries, so that an abuser is not unblocked;
kept.tokenSenders: the address in the allowed senders of an API token (update the token to remove it);
kept.auditIps: client IP addresses in the audit log, until their 12-month retention ends;
kept.queuedMails: mails already queued for sending, whose links keep working as long as the transfer exists (a received transfer that has other recipients is kept);
kept.backups: backups: their copies of the files become unreadable, since the keys are destroyed.

erase.conflict: A transfer of this address is being uploaded. What was already erased stays erased: try again in {wait} to complete the erasure.
erase.conflictNow: A transfer of this address is being uploaded. What was already erased stays erased: try again in a moment to complete the erasure.

report.title: Erasure report
report.done: The data linked to the address has been erased from this entity.
report.auditHint: The erasure is recorded in the audit log without the address; its pseudonym appears as the object of the entry.
